symptom: `create external entities from M.Sales` dropped a property typed `Vendor.Sales.OrderStatus` (an EnumType). `alter entity M.Order add attribute Status: String(unlimited)` or `Enumeration(M.OrderStatus)` passed check and exec, then mx check 11.12.6 reported CE6612 "Attribute 'Status' of external entity 'Order' is not supported."
file: mdl/executor/cmd_contract_enums.go odataEnumerations.ensure (called from cmd_contract.go's attribute loop); model.Enumeration/EnumerationValue Remote* + mdl/backend/modelsdk/enumeration{,_write}.go; carryRemoteEnumeration in cmd_enumerations.go; externalEntityAddAttributeRefusal in cmd_entities.go + validate.go. Tests: mdl/backend/modelsdk/enumeration_remote_2477_test.go, mdl/executor/cmd_contract_enums_2477_test.go, mdl/executor/alter_entity_external_2477_test.go
cause: The importer had no enum mapping; a hand-added attribute is a DomainModels$StoredValue where an external entity needs Rest$ODataMappedValue (CE6612 for any type, AllowCreateChangeLocally or not); and the enumeration model had no field for Rest$ODataRemoteEnumerationSource, so neither could be written and a rebuild dropped a stored one.
insight: **Hand-edit the BSON toward the hypothesis and let mx check name the next requirement**: mapping the attribute alone gave CE4597, whose text ('should have an enumeration type that was generated from X in service Y') named the RemoteSource; adding Rest$ODataRemoteEnumerationSource + a RemoteValue per value gave 0 errors. Two edits replaced a Studio Pro reference. Control for the carry: a build without it turned a `create or modify enumeration` rewrite into CE4597.
